# Keyflow package

`legitminh-keyflow-0.1.1.tgz` is the installable distribution of `@legitminh/keyflow`, extracted into the standalone local repository at `/Users/minh/Projects/cs/keyflow`.

It contains the compiled JavaScript, Svelte components, TypeScript declarations, CSS, and integration README. It contains no site content or build-time dependency on the sibling repository. The source repository has its own Git history, demo, tests, and CI workflow.

See the website README for updates and the sibling repository's README for reuse in another Svelte 5 project. This archive is checked in because the package has not been published remotely.
